keys.raw: bare strings from store.rawSet; null = unset

excluded: photo library and personal background images, garage (parts, liveries, setup sheets, MY TEAM), saves (career, the season save, replays, daily challenge), accounts and network (Spotify, TURN, relays), renderer self-heal latches, developer flags. Time-trial leaderboards are optional in the ttlb section, and season setup, circuit mastery, ghosts, onboarding marks and your own circuits in the progress section (best laps and progress merge, season setup is replaced)

where.display.hudBtnScale: js/ui/scale.js + css/tokens.css (null = factory size: phone 143.25, tablet 125, fine pointer 100; displayed as 100%)
where.display.hudPanelOpacity: js/ui/scale.js PANEL OPACITY (null = 100%; HIGH CONTRAST keeps plates solid)
where.appearance.pauseLayout: js/ui/pause-opts.js PAUSE MENU › LAYOUT (grid | list | compact | wide | sidebar)
where.appearance.titleLayout: js/ui/title-layout.js TITLE LAYOUT (null = shipped; else {v:2, wide, tall}, one {btns,title,art,layout,side} per shape — a missing shape is shipped; a v1 object is both)
where.appearance.lookDatahub: js/ui/screen-looks.js DATA HUB (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.lookRace: js/ui/screen-looks.js RACE SETTINGS (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.lookCareer: js/ui/screen-looks.js CAREER (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.lookGarage: js/ui/screen-looks.js GARAGE (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.lookPopups: js/ui/screen-looks.js POPUPS (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.lookDesigner: js/ui/screen-looks.js TRACK DESIGNER (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.layoutPreset: js/ui/layout-presets.js LAYOUT PRESET (null = none recorded; the last preset applied — it reads CUSTOM once the knobs above no longer match it)
where.display.portraitOk: js/game.js RACE IN PORTRAIT ("1" = race upright, else the rotate blocker)
where.display.gfxBackend: js/perf/renderer-picker.js + js/render/renderer-boot.js (unset = TLX when a GPU adapter resolves, else GLX — skips three.webgpu)
where.hud.hudElements: js/ui/hud-elements.js phone and desktop visibility defaults
where.hud.hudLayout: js/ui/hud-layout.js MOVE & SIZE (null = shipped; else {v:4, standard?, minimal?, broadcast?}, each {cockpit, helmet, other} of {id: {x, y, s}} with optional width/minHeight in viewport shares and textSize in percent on text panels; offsets are finite and size positive finite, without visual bounds. Missing elements in saved layouts use automatic placement)
where.driving.dockLayout: js/ui/dock-layout.js (touch control placement, spacing, layout, sizes and shapes by steering scheme)
